product.name: AI-enabled food safety solutions
product.description: Provides food safety solutions using AI for audit, inspection, testing, and certification globally.

product.name: Sustainable water safety solutions
product.description: Offers eco-friendly water treatment solutions to minimize loss and ensure sustainable use.

product.name: Chemical Free Water Treatments
product.description: Utilizes chemical-free technologies for water treatment, including electrolysis for pipe and tank protection.

product.name: Cooling Tower Treatment
product.description: Chemical-free solution for preventing corrosion, scale, and bio-fouling in cooling towers.

product.name: Legionella Pneumophila Bacteria Control
product.description: Develops systems for minimizing the presence and threat of Legionella Pneumophila bacteria in water systems.

product.name: EEC/EEO Water and Wastewater Treatment
product.description: Employs systems without chemical additives for removing contaminants from water and wastewater.
